question: The Lauria Nandangarh Pillar is located in _________.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Bihar.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The Lauria Nandangarh Pillar is Located In the **Champaran District Of Bihar**__. 
 
• Remains of the Mauryan period have been set up then. 
 
• Lauriya Nandangarh is also a point for about **__20 archaeological banks organized in three rows. __**
 
• Forty pillars were erected then by **__Emperor Ashoka__** firstly but a moment only one pillar exists in complete form, at its original position in Lauriya __**Nandangarh. **__
 
• It's positioned near the banks of the** Burhi Gandak River. **
 
• Many times latterly **Henry Bailey Wade** Garrick shovelled several mounds with indifferent results.
